entries.public_goal: Find the real pepper grinder whose reflection appears inside the red outline on the mirror in the initial head-camera view. Pick up that real pepper grinder, lift it at least 5 cm, and release it on the blue pad.

public.objective: Find the real pepper grinder whose reflection appears inside the red outline on the mirror in the initial head-camera view. Pick up that real pepper grinder, lift it at least 5 cm, and release it on the blue pad.
public.success_criteria: Use a genuine robot grasp to lift each required pepper grinder at least 5 cm. Leave all required pepper grinders supported and released without robot contact for at least 0.5 seconds, with linear speed at most 0.02 m/s and angular speed at most 0.1 rad/s. Leave the working hand empty and open, withdraw the robot hands from the pepper grinders, and declare DONE.
public.environment: A furnished dining room with pepper grinders on a fixed deck over an existing native table, a physical mirror, a red rectangular outline, blue and yellow delivery pads, and a fixed yellow reference pillar.
constraints: Keep the table, pads, mirror, red outline and yellow reference pillar fixed; preserve all object dimensions.
Use the existing guarded public controls and robot-mounted observations.
Interpret the requested appearance using the initial head-camera view. Later robot movement does not redefine the requested real pepper grinder.
The first candidate grasp commits the real-object selection. Do not grasp a different candidate.
Keep each unselected pepper grinder within 2 cm of its starting position.

geometry_proposal.scope: Saved static collision bounds, bounding-center height and approximate head eye; actual native collision centroid, projection, support and optics must qualify.

revision_evidence.geometry: Native pepper grinders have fixed metadata joints, which set articulated=True. Household measurement now requires actual n_dof=0 and n_joints=0 and the same single enabled root collision link; no assets or physical thresholds change.
revision_evidence.office: R-C2 initial robot contacted swivel_chair_ucawqa_5. Retain both central west chairs and move them to open north corners during initialization, preserving their original height, orientation and physical properties.
revision_evidence.invariants: All candidates, cue geometry, pads, anchors, goals, scoring, seeds and budgets remain unchanged. R-A1/R-A2 share identical furniture changes.
revision_evidence.scope: Definitions and initialization only; original failures remain immutable.
